title: 第13章 栽赃陷害第14章 少爷替你出气
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“叶云飞少爷，你快去救救小月吧，小月被家族执法堂的人带走了，正在被严刑拷问！”
叶云飞刚走出房门，一个丫环冲进了院子，急匆匆地叫道。
“红梅，怎么了？
小月出了什么事？”
叶云飞眼神一冷。
红梅，是叶家下人之中，少有的，和小月走得较近，感情较好的一个。
“叶强少爷不见了一颗真灵丹，春芳出来作证，说她曾经亲眼看见，小月偷偷从叶强少爷的房间出来。
所以，家族执法堂的叶管事，带着执法堂的人，来把小月抓走，正在审问。
叶云飞少爷，你快去救救小月吧，否则，小月会被他们打死的。”
红梅焦急地说道。
“春芳是谁。”
叶云飞的目光之中，满是冷意。
“春芳是叶强少爷的贴身丫环。”
红梅答道。
“叶强！
呵呵，好，好的很！
你敢动我叶云飞的人，真是不知死活！”
一刹那！
一股森冷之极的气息，从叶云飞的身上散发出来，眼神中，闪烁着彻骨的杀意。
叶云飞百分之百肯定，这是对小月的栽赃陷害。

小月从六岁起，就进入叶家，一直跟在叶云飞身旁。
叶云飞出事，成为一个废人后，叶家之中，绝大部分下人，都好像避瘟疫一样，避开叶云飞。
只有小月，对叶云飞一点也没有变，反而是更加关心，更加体贴。
可以说，小月虽然名义上是叶云飞的丫环，但是，在叶云飞的心目中，一直把小月当作是自己的亲妹妹。
有人敢动小月，就等于是，动了叶云飞的逆鳞！
“呵呵，叶家，还真不把我这个少爷，当少爷了。
是时候，给叶家，动一动手术，清除一些祸患了。”
叶云飞冷笑。
“红梅，多谢你来给我送信。
接下来的事，你就不要管了。”
叶云飞回房间内，取了一柄长剑，杀气腾腾，抬步向执法堂的方向，大步走去。
叶家的执法堂，在家族府邸的西边。
“站住！
执法堂是家族重地，任何人未经允许，不得擅闯！”
执法堂的大门外，两个守卫，看见叶云飞手持长剑而来，先是一愣，然后，齐声喝斥。
这些年来，家族执法堂，实际上，已经被叶仲年三父子，牢牢控制住。
所以，执法堂的人，对叶云飞这个所谓的叶家大少爷，根本就不屑一顾。
“谁敢拦我，死。”
content_en:
"Master Ye Yunfei, go and save Xiaoyue quickly. Xiaoyue was taken away by people from the family law enforcement hall and is being tortured!"
As soon as Ye Yunfei walked out of the room, a maid rushed into the yard and shouted hurriedly.
"Hongmei, what's wrong?
What happened to Xiaoyue? "
Ye Yunfei's eyes turned cold.
Hongmei is one of the few servants of the Ye family who is closer to Xiaoyue and has a better relationship with her.
"Master Ye Qiang has lost a true elixir. Chunfang came out to testify, saying that she once saw Xiaoyue sneaking out of Master Ye Qiang's room.
Therefore, Manager Ye from the Family Law Enforcement Hall came with people from the Law Enforcement Hall to arrest Xiaoyue and was interrogating her.
Young Master Ye Yunfei, go and save Xiaoyue, otherwise, Xiaoyue will be beaten to death by them. "
Hongmei said anxiously.
"Who is Chunfang?"
Ye Yunfei's eyes were full of coldness.
"Chunfang is Master Ye Qiang's personal maid."
Hongmei replied.
"Ye Qiang!
Haha, good, good!
You dare to touch my Ye Yunfei's people, you really don't know how to live or die! "
A moment!
An extremely cold aura emanated from Ye Yunfei's body, and his eyes flashed with murderous intent.
Ye Yunfei was 100% sure that this was a frame-up of Xiaoyue.
Xiaoyue has entered Ye's family since she was six years old and has been by Ye Yunfei's side.
After Ye Yunfei had an accident and became a disabled person, most of the servants in the Ye family avoided Ye Yunfei like the plague.
Only Xiaoyue didn't change at all towards Ye Yunfei, but instead became more caring and considerate.
It can be said that although Xiaoyue is nominally Ye Yunfei's maid, in Ye Yunfei's mind, he has always regarded Xiaoyue as his biological sister.
If anyone dares to touch Xiaoyue, it is equivalent to touching Ye Yunfei's reverse scale!
"Haha, the Ye family really doesn't regard me as a young master as a young master.
It's time to perform an operation on the Ye family to eliminate some troubles. "
Ye Yunfei sneered.
"Hongmei, thank you for coming to deliver this letter to me.
Don't worry about what happens next. "
Ye Yunfei returned to the room, took out a long sword, and strode towards the direction of the law enforcement hall with murderous intent.
The Ye family's law enforcement hall is to the west of the family mansion.
"Stop!
The Law Enforcement Hall is an important place for the family and no one is allowed to trespass without permission! "
Outside the gate of the Law Enforcement Hall, two guards saw Ye Yunfei coming with a long sword. They were stunned for a moment, and then they shouted in unison.
Over the years, the family law enforcement hall has actually been firmly controlled by Ye Zhongnian and his son.
Therefore, the people in the Law Enforcement Hall looked down upon Ye Yunfei, the so-called eldest young master of the Ye family.
"Whoever dares to stop me will die."
